title: [main] feature 623913 - EET 2.0
summary: Implements EET 2.0 message format and security model for Czech electronic sales registration with new taxpayer identity and authorization fields, corrected production endpoint, response security verification, and updated UI documentation.
key_points: Adds Taxpayer ID and Authorizing Taxpayer ID fields for own sale, direct and indirect representation, and authorization scenarios
Introduces Unit ID field to replace the old Identification field in EET messages
Verifies response certificate validity and subject against specification requirements
Updates production endpoint and adds SOAPAction header for EET 2.0 compliance
Reorganizes UI with new field groups for Taxpayer and Authorization on EET Service Setup and Entry Card
quote: Adds the implementation of the new EET 2.0 (Czech electronic registration of sales) message format and security model.
